0.for: Aerial wide shot of a small black basalt island in the South Pacific with a towering white steam-and-ash column erupting from the sea beside it, dark turquoise swell, low overcast Pacific dusk light, deep basalt-black shadows, fine 35mm grain.

8.for: Wide aerial of dark pre-dawn Pacific ocean with a faint glow on the horizon and low overcast cloud, deep basalt-black water.

11.for: Aerial shot of two small dark volcanic islands joined by a pale isthmus of new tephra, ringed by turquoise shallow water and dark swell.

16.for: Aerial of a raw black tephra plain connecting two volcanic islands, steaming pumice flats, turquoise water.

17.for: Top-down aerial of a newly enlarged dark volcanic island with a pale ash apron on grey-green sea, thin cloud.

21.for: High aerial of an explosive volcanic blast in the Pacific throwing a pale ash-laden cloud outward across the sea, black water beneath.

4.for: Wide shot from a shoreline of an enormous grey-white ash plume climbing vertically from the sea into a pale stratospheric sky, dark sea in the foreground.

12.for: Wide aerial of a submerged caldera rim of dark basalt under churning turquoise Pacific swell, ring of shallow reef water, overcast sky.

3.for: Telephoto shot of a glassy Pacific swell disturbed by a rising wall of white steam and grey ash breaking the surface, dark sky, far horizon.

27.for: Wide shot of a Surtseyan-style eruption: black ash and white steam bursting from shallow turquoise water, dark volcanic rubble around the vent.

31.for: Seen just above the swell: a wall of white steam and dark tephra bursting through churning turquoise-grey Pacific water, the sea black beneath, gas columns breaking into low overcast dusk light with fine atmospheric haze.

35.for: An infrared-toned view of towering cloud tops over dark ocean, the coldest tops pale and the warmer slopes darker, a flat grey lid of cloud marking the tropopause under thin haze.

56.for: High-altitude stratospheric horizon seen from a balloon at dusk: flat-topped vapour anvils far below, a sky gradient running from warm grey at the horizon to deep basalt-black overhead, faint incandescent glow along the curve, fine 35mm grain.

82.for: Submerged basalt caldera rim beneath a churning turquoise Pacific swell with columns of gas breaking the surface, dusk light, atmospheric haze, dark water against faint magma-orange reflections, wide-angle 65mm.
